# VendingNI

- Canonical website: https://vendingni.com/
- Contact: info@vendingni.com
- Last updated: 2026-10-05
- Service: Fully managed vending services for qualifying organisations.
- Positioning: A straightforward route for qualifying organisations to explore managed vending without buying, stocking or managing the machine themselves.
- Coverage: across the UK (England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland). Northern Ireland coverage includes Belfast, Antrim, Lisburn, Dungannon and Mallusk. Service coverage in the Republic of Ireland continues as the Ireland pages state.
- Operating model: VendingNI receives commercial enquiries, assesses site requirements, recommends suitable solutions and arranges managed vending service. Service delivery is supported through an established vending network.
- Attribution: Some operational capabilities and venue examples reflect experience across the wider vending network.

## Qualification and service facts

- Managed vending is available only for qualifying locations and is subject to assessment.
- Eligibility, equipment availability and the final service arrangement are not guaranteed; interactive tools provide indicative guidance only.
- Assessment considers population or footfall, operating hours, shifts, site type, placement and service access.
- Approximate network guidelines include 40 regular workplace users, 50 hotel rooms and 200 apartments; these are not guarantees.
- Managed arrangements can include machine provision, installation, replenishment, product management, maintenance and technical support.
- Contactless and mobile-wallet payments, and remote monitoring, depend on compatible equipment and the selected setup.
- Compatible telemetry may report stock, transactions, product selections, alerts or machine status; it is not available on every installation.
- Managed service delivery is supported through the wider vending network under the agreed site arrangement.
- The primary enquiry route is [info@vendingni.com](mailto:info@vendingni.com).

## Interactive vending tools

- [Free vending machine eligibility checker](https://vendingni.com/free-vending-machine-eligibility-checker/) — indicative, permissive site-fit guidance; not an approval.
- [Vending machine selector](https://vendingni.com/vending-machine-selector/) — indicative setup recommendation subject to site assessment.
- [Managed vs buy vs rent cost calculator](https://vendingni.com/vending-machine-cost-calculator/) — structural comparison without assumed equipment prices.
